- Materials: Adept Craft Kit x 1, Tool Crafting Part x 8, Strong Iron Ore x 15, Rare Relic x 15, Ancient Relic x 24, Gold x 100

- Materials: Adept Craft Kit x 1, Tool Crafting Part x 8, Strong Iron Ore x 15, Rare Relic x 15, Ancient Relic x 24, Gold x 100"
}
